messages.subject: INLA keeps Crashing
parts:
Dear INLA expert

I'm trying to model several alternative models.
Spatial Model, INLA is running fine
Temporal Model, INLA is doing well
Spatiotemporal Model, INLA works well
but when modeling Spatiotemporal with interactions
INLA always crashes with this message:

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2

I really needs your helps

Thankyou
